name: api-1160sps-60s
title: API ingest load: 1160 spans/s for 60 s (100.2 M requests/day equivalent)
summary: Open-model OTLP/HTTP (JSON) load against the gateway's OTLP front door of the local single-node Compose stack (gateway → Collector in its network namespace → metrics writer → PostgreSQL). 10 tenants with one service each; every simulated tenant request is a local-root SERVER span, 50 spans per OTLP request (23.20 requests/s). After the run the control-plane API must report exactly the accepted spans as requests. 10× the design target (C-48) is 115.7 requests/s.

checks.name: derived request counts in the API equal the accepted spans
checks.detail: accepted 69600, API requests 69600, visible 0 s after the run

notes:

| POST /v1/traces (50 spans) → 200 | 5.7 | 11.8 | 18.0 | 26.9 |

Limits of this run: one host, one edge node (gateway + Collector), one writer; client and stack share the CPU.
